title: The Invoices import template has the headers *Line Title and Line Description
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions, including Settings → Data Import) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings and, under Data Import, click Invoices.
  2. Download the template (sample file).
  3. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet.
  4. Read the header row from *Item to Tech Story.
  5. Search the header row for "What are you doing".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: a sample file downloads.
  • Step 4: right after *Item come "*Line Title" and then "Line Description" (the 16th and 17th columns, P and Q), followed by Tech Story.
  • Step 5: "What are you doing" is not found in the header row (nor "Why are you doing it").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S4-R2, S4-R6, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-015, Phase 4 and D4; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).
